title: Chevening Europe Defence and Security Fellowship
official_source: Chevening (UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office scheme), delivered by Cranfield University
duration: Six weeks, in two cohorts: Cohort 1 25 January - 5 March 2027; Cohort 2 15 March - 23 April 2027
description: The Chevening Europe Defence and Security Fellowship, delivered by Cranfield University, is a six-week Chevening Fellowship for mid-career professionals who are citizens and residents of 35 listed European countries and who work in defence, security and related fields. The fellowship covers full programme fees, living expenses with pre-arranged accommodation close to Oxford, return economy airfare, a monthly personal living allowance and related allowances.

title: Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Promotionsförderung für Ausländer:innen (FES doctoral scholarship for international doctoral candidates)
duration: As a rule three and a half years; in justified exceptional cases it can be granted for longer, but at the latest until the final examination
description: The Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung funds doctoral candidates from abroad who are admitted to a German university, paying 1,500 euros a month plus a supplement for statutory health insurance, together with an extensive political education programme. title: France 2030 - PEPR GFM "Grands Fonds Marins" - Appel à projets - 2026
official_source: Agence nationale de la recherche (ANR), France 2030 / CNRS, Ifremer, IRD
duration: Projects must run between 36 and 54 months.
description: The France 2030 PEPR 'Grands Fonds Marins' call for projects stimulates the creation of new wide-interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary research consortia on deep-sea environments, from the ocean floor and its subsoil to the water column below 200 metres. The call is a single phase, with projects of 36 to 54 months requesting 800 kEUR to 3 M EUR of ANR funding within a total envelope of approximately 17.5 M EUR, awarded to French higher education and research institutions.

title: France 2030 - PEPR PROPSY – "Psychiatrie de précision" - Appel à projets - 2026
official_source: Agence nationale de la recherche (ANR), France 2030 / PEPR PROPSY piloté par l'Inserm et le CNRS avec la Fondation FondaMental
duration: 24 to 48 months for the pre-clinical axis; 36 to 48 months for the clinical and mixed axes.
description: Financed by France 2030, the PEPR PROPSY is a national programme piloted by Inserm and the CNRS in partnership with the Fondation FondaMental, aiming to transform the care of four disabling psychiatric disorders. This 2026 call funds precision-psychiatry research projects covering pre-clinical studies, clinical studies identifying or validating biomarkers, clinical trials and mixed projects.
